text_block_list.text: (Waah...!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*, *gasp*... ――Such... 
incredible cheering.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(So many more voices, far louder than any 
of the kids' races I ran when I was 
little.)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (I'm... really here...!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Do you have the "Tales of Heroes" 
with you right now!?

Before I even have a chance to praise her 
for a good race, I open "The Tale of Zenno 
Rob Roy's Heroism" just as she asked.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"There's something I absolutely need you 
to write down right this second—"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Are you listening? Here I go... ..."I am"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ‘I'll definitely become a true hero.’

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"I will weave a heroic tale worthy of a 
stage like the Japan Derby"...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...W-Were you able to write it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
T-Thank you so much! Sorry for the sudden 
outburst, hearing all the cheering... My 
heart just felt so full.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I want to bathe in these cheers again... 
No, I want to hear cheers even louder than 
this.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...For that to happen, I have to become a 
real hero!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh?

"Hearing that, I vividly pictured the 
image of a hero being greeted by 
thunderous applause"—

"And she strongly believed that it would 
become the truth." ...Those were the words 
added to the page.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "W-Wah... ...I'm so happy."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'll... I'll do my very best in 
the Derby! With everything I've got...!

"Zenno Rob Roy has taken a powerful first 
step forward upon the royal road."

Next is finally the Japan Derby... I can't 
help but hope that her heroic tale turns 
out to be magnificent!
